notes: Not a channel-letter sign: Spencer's 2026 front is a faux red-brick storefront with a rusty steel-angle frame; the 'sign' is a spray-painted graffiti 'Spencer's' on the half-raised black roll-down security shutter over the entry, lit only by the mall lights. Backer = the visible shutter (about 2.3 x 1.0 m, guessed from the brick courses). The shutter's background is a red/pink/blue/purple spray-paint wash with horizontal slat lines: the builder takes one backer colour, so it is the median purple (#8c5f96); a printed backer texture would be truer (the format can't take one). Letters: two traced vinyl layers, the black outline/drop-shadow silhouette (also covers the thin white rim) and the orange fill on top (deeper by 3 mm so it sits in front). Orange corrected from the warm frame. The band above is the plain cream mall wall; the piers either side are faux brick.
